item.title: Contribute to the aws Terraform Provider
item.description:
Configure Development Environment

  • Install Terraform and go
    • I used the version in the default Ubuntu apt repos
  • Using ZSH
    • If you are using zsh I recommend adding the following line to your .zshrc export PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin"
    • Credits to mmik in this post

item.title: Fastest way to create a homelab Kubernetes cluster
item.description:
Talos is preconfigured operating system that makes it easy to setup your control plane and get nodes added.

You can read more about them here. Talos

I recommend creating a Proxmox cluster and utilizing this doc Talos Proxmox guide

Once you have a VM created you can follow my Homelab-Configuration to create templates that can be used to deploy as many nodes as you would like.

In the end you should have a working cluster
